mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a voluntary process in which a neutral third party, who is usually an expert in the field in which the dispute arises gives binding determination on the issues in dispute."
Expert determination is a voluntary process in which a neutral third party, who is usually an expert in the field in which the dispute arises gives binding determination on the issues in dispute.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a non-binding, adversarial dispute resolution process in which one or more arbitrators hear arguments, weigh evidence and issue a non-binding judgment on the merits after an expedited hearing."

Compulsory Arbitration is a non-binding, adversarial dispute resolution process in which one or more arbitrators hear arguments, weigh evidence and issue a non-binding judgment on the merits after an expedited hearing.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the ability to gain information on the best alternatives available to the other party."
A more tasking aspect is the ability to gain information on the best alternatives available to the other party.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means of settling disputes though recognized by the Act has not been of much use compared to other processes."
Conciliation as a means of settling disputes though recognized by the Act has not been of much use compared to other processes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a court connected Alternative Dispute Centre which offers different forms of alternative dispute resolution processes."
A multi-door courthouse is a court connected Alternative Dispute Centre which offers different forms of alternative dispute resolution processes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a tactic that can be used by a party on whom an advantage has been conferred."
Nibble is a tactic that can be used by a party on whom an advantage has been conferred.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the mostly used of the processes in Nigeria."
Mediation as an ADR process is one of the mostly used of the processes in Nigeria.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most recognized and established form of dispute resolution system in Nigeria and even in the world today."
Litigation is the most recognized and established form of dispute resolution system in Nigeria and even in the world today.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a procedure for settlement of disputes between parties to a contract without recourse to the court of law."
Arbitration is a procedure for settlement of disputes between parties to a contract without recourse to the court of law.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a popular method used at the Lagos Multi-Door Courthouse due to its advantages."
Mediation is a popular method used at the Lagos Multi-Door Courthouse due to its advantages.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the Arbitration Act, 1914 and the Arbitration and Conciliation Decree 1988."
Older versions are the Arbitration Act, 1914 and the Arbitration and Conciliation Decree 1988.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used between parties to resolve disputes arising out of commercial/contractual agreements, without the formalities of litigation and regular court procedures."
The process of arbitration is used between parties to resolve disputes arising out of commercial/contractual agreements, without the formalities of litigation and regular court procedures.
